title: Single sign-on
description: Let your people sign in through your identity provider (SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect) and keep them in sync over SCIM.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Each connection links one identity provider. A new connection starts off: turn it on when the provider is set up.
connections.none: No connections yet. Add one to let your people sign in with SSO.
connections.discoveryError: Provider metadata could not be fetched: {{error}}
connections.discoveryPending: Provider metadata is being fetched. Sign-in is unavailable until it arrives.
connections.testOff: Turn the connection on to test a sign-in.
connections.removeDescription: Nobody can sign in through it any more. Accounts stay; their SSO link to this connection is removed.
connections.created: Added {{name}}. It is off until you turn it on.

form.description: Secrets and certificates are stored safely and never shown again.
form.name: Name
form.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL, starting with https://.
form.issuerHint: The provider’s OpenID Connect issuer. Its discovery document is fetched after saving.
form.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current secret.
form.idpEntityIdHint: What the provider names as the issuer of its assertions.
form.certificateHint: Only assertions signed by it are accepted.
form.certificateKeep: Leave empty to keep the current certificates.
form.nextCertificateHint: Add it while the provider rotates its certificate.
form.allowIdpInitiated: Accept sign-ins started by the provider
form.allowIdpInitiatedHint: Weaker against login CSRF. Leave off unless the provider can only start the sign-in itself.
form.jitHint: A person of a verified domain who is not a member yet joins with no roles.
form.enabledHint: Off, the connection signs nobody in.

domains.title: Email domains
domains.description: Only addresses of a verified domain sign in or are provisioned through SSO, so a tenant can’t claim someone else’s addresses.
domains.checking: Looking the record up. Reload in a moment to see the result.
domains.publish: Publish this DNS record, then check it.

scim.title: SCIM provisioning
scim.description: The identity provider creates, updates and deactivates people and groups over SCIM 2.0.
scim.step1: Make a role with the single permission “Provision SCIM” (Roles).
scim.step2: Create an API client with that role and copy its key (API clients).
scim.step3: Give the identity provider the base URL and the key as its bearer token.
scim.clients: API clients and their last call
scim.noClients: No API client yet, so no SCIM key either.
scim.noAccess: To see the API clients that hold the key, you need permission to manage API clients.
